name: BnF fr. 3151 no. 33, Francois de Noailles (Venice) to the Cardinal de Lorraine, 13 Nov 1558, three cipher blocks on f.60r/v with a contemporary marginal decipherment partly lost in the gutter
ciphertext: ciphers/fr3151-noailles-1558/align/ciphertext_draft_block{1,2,3}.tsv (NX-3151G, 26 Sept 2026, two blind Sonnet passes reconciled at 45.8/30.8/51.3 pct, 306 signs, DRAFT -- not settled, alphabet unsettled: 22 symbol codes plus unk1-8, numerals 1-70)
ciphertext_source: Gallica ark:/12148/btv1b9059865k canvases 61 (f.60r, region 3900,0,4030,5659) and 62 (f.60v), native resolution, images/manifest.json and images/crops/manifest.json
alphabet: invented pen-drawn symbols (about 22 shapes, images/crops/sign_legend.md) mixed with one- and two-digit Arabic numerals; same mixed design as the Seure letters (fr3151-seure-1558) bound in the same recueil, key not shown to be shared
constraints: a contemporary marginal decipherment (period gloss) sits beside each block, cut by the binding: about 35 surviving letters beside block 1's 83 signs, illegible fragments beside block 2's 65, two disagreeing M-grade witnesses of about 72 letters beside block 3's 158
the gloss wraps on the margin's own line widths (7 gloss lines beside block 3's 6 cipher lines), so gloss line i is not cipher line i
no period key, no printed clear text found: Charriere Negociations II (full-text grep), Ribier 1666 (both tomes) read, see NOTES.md check-solved and web/blog sections
subject from the clear text: Levant galleys, Candia, Corfu; sender's hand is the secretary's, gloss in a smaller court hand
cheap_tests_in_order: align the surviving margin gloss to its block with tools/interlinear_align.py (one pair per block), key from the alignment, shuffled-gloss control, and a synthetic positive control cut to the same gloss coverage; decode and judge only if cleared (LIKELY-5, 2 Oct 2026)

after the sign alphabet is settled by a person (tools/sign_sorter.py) or the gutter-lost gloss is captured: re-run test 1 only if its positive control clears at the new coverage; else a homophonic/nomenclator family_run.py on the settled transcription with its matched control
